requirements.requirement: The system must map clinical trial status 'RECRUITING' to the highest normalized score defined in the schema.
The system must map 'ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING' to a lower score than 'RECRUITING' but higher than all closed or inactive statuses.
The system must map 'COMPLETED' status to a lower score than all active statuses.
The system must map 'TERMINATED' status to the lowest possible score among defined statuses.
The system must map 'UNKNOWN' or missing status values to a default low score defined in the schema.
The system must ensure all computed status scores are normalized within the range defined by the schema (e.g., 0 to 1).
The system must produce deterministic scores such that identical input statuses always yield identical output scores.
The system must compute a status score for every clinical trial record returned by clinical_trials_service.
The system must not alter or remove existing filtering logic for 'RECRUITING' trials while adding scoring logic.
The system must derive the score solely from the API-provided status field without introducing non-deterministic or external factors.
The system must handle unexpected status values by mapping them to the 'UNKNOWN' category score without throwing runtime errors.
The system must handle null or missing status fields by assigning the 'UNKNOWN' score and continuing processing.
The system must execute status-to-score mapping in constant time per record (no iterative or probabilistic scoring logic).
The system must ensure scoring logic is implemented as a single centralized mapping function within clinical_trials_service.
The system must return the computed score as a numeric value attached to each trial object in the service layer output.
